description: The low-rank routing path (wins shapes 3/4/8/10/12) still spends ~40-50% of its runtime in the inner cuSOLVER eigh on the k-by-k Rayleigh block (brief-7 profile: laed3/gemvx/symv are cuSOLVER-internal to that reduced eigh). Accelerate the inner solve. For the reduced blocks with k<=448 (dense512 k=352, rankdef512 k=384, lapgeom1024 k=384) route the block through the RAW fused megakernel primitive (mega_eigh_med / _eigh_megakernel_med) called DIRECTLY as an inner solver -- brief-7's regression when it tried this was the top-level wrapper's per-call scratch allocs + its own full gate + sort, so expose or inline a bare kernel entry that consumes the reduced block and returns (Qk,Lk) with no wrapper overhead. For the k>448 blocks (dense1024 k=608, nearrank1024 k=768) build a bf16/TF32 tensor-core reduction or Chebyshev/subspace iteration on the reduced block (its spectrum is concentrated by construction). Keep the outer FP32 randomized subspace + CholeskyQR2 and the cheap FP32 A@V-reusing residual gate; per-matrix cuSOLVER fallback unchanged. Forks best 9949a990 so it deepens all existing low-rank wins.

Bare megakernel inner solve for the low-rank Rayleigh block (k<=448): _lr_reduced_eigh routes Bk (B,k,k) directly through mega_eigh (k<=200) / mega_eigh_med (200<k<=448) with persistent (B,k)-cached scratch, NO wrapper gate, NO sort (outer path re-sorts + gates). brief-7 t5's +41% regression was the top-level wrapper's per-call 7-buffer alloc + own residual gate (af@Q GEMM on k-blocks) + sort. Geomean 43301->41363us (~4.5%). shape3 dense512 k=352 132037->109636; shape8 rankdef512 k=384 153142->120977; shape12 lapgeom1024 k=384 55423->46525. shapes4/10 (k=608/768>448) unchanged=cuSOLVER. nsys: cuSOLVER laed3/gemvx/symv GONE from shape3, replaced by one mega_eigh_med_k (48.8%, 52ms). Validated 39/39.

Nested randomized-subspace inner solve for k>448 (project Bk to k2=384, megakernel the reduced-reduced block, Rayleigh complement) REGRESSED: shape4 dense1024 k=608 83970->164894 (+96%), shape10 nearrank1024 k=768 104921->170138 (+62%). Geomean 41363->45231. Root cause: k2=384 too small to capture k=608/768 -> Vd2 non-orthonormal -> outer gate falls whole batch to full-n cuSOLVER on top of wasted nested GEMMs. k<=448 shapes 3/8/12 unchanged from t1. 39/39 validate. Need k2 close to k (won't fit megakernel) OR a different k>448 primitive.

Revert k>448 to cuSOLVER (nested subspace inner solve dead at k2=384 and 448); removed dead _lr_reduced_nested. Banks the clean k<=448 bare-megakernel win: geomean 41353us == trial 1. shapes 4/10 back to cuSOLVER floor (84027/104863), k<=448 shapes 3/8/12 keep megakernel (109711/120981/46413). Clean base. 39/39 validate.

cusolverDnXsyevBatched proven NOT genuinely batched (k<=448 probe: shapes 3/8/12 = cuSOLVER floor 131764/153181/55431; shape4 nsys shows same symv/gemvx/laed3 syevd machinery looped). Removed the Xsyev extension; reverted inner router to best (megakernel 32<k<=448, cuSOLVER k>448). Geomean 41367us == trial 1/3 best. shapes 3/8/12 megakernel 109674/120977/46483; shapes 4/10 cuSOLVER floor 83986/104840. 39/39 validate.

_eigh_custom (Python blocked-Householder tridiag + bisect/twisted + GEMM back-transform) for k>448 regressed 5.4x (shape4 84027->457833, shape10 104885->569301) -- per-column Python loop latency-bound. Reverted k>448 to cuSOLVER. Geomean 41383us == best. Three k>448 inner solvers now refuted (nested-subspace +60-96%, Xsyev neutral, _eigh_custom 5.4x). shapes 3/8/12 megakernel; shapes 4/10 cuSOLVER floor. 39/39 validate.

Spectral 2-way matrix-sign split for k>448 (sigma=mean, NS sign projector, two k//2 sub-blocks each megakernel'd) REGRESSED: shape4 83869->165035 (+96%), shape10 104885->179335 (+71%). Same failure as nested (t2): fixed k//2 half-width mismatches true above-mean count + TF32 NS sign inaccurate -> subspace mixing -> non-orthonormal lift -> outer gate falls whole batch to full-n cuSOLVER on top of split work. Geomean 45445. k<=448 shapes 3/8/12 unchanged. FOUR k>448 solvers refuted (nested, Xsyev, _eigh_custom, spectral-split). 39/39 validate.

FINAL BEST: revert spectral split, k>448 on cuSOLVER floor. The low-rank inner reduced eigh Bk routes through the RAW megakernel (mega_eigh k<=200 / mega_eigh_med 200<k<=448) with persistent scratch, no wrapper gate, no sort. Geomean 41378us, ~4.5% under parent 43301. shapes 3/8/12 (k<=448) win: dense512 132037->109627 (-17%), rankdef512 153142->121020 (-21%), lapgeom1024 55423->46508 (-16%). shapes 4/10 (k=608/768>448) cuSOLVER floor -- four k>448 solvers refuted (nested subspace, Xsyev, _eigh_custom, spectral-split). 39/39 validate. Stable across 4 re-benchmarks (41353-41383).

BANKED the brief's primary directive: bare-megakernel inner solve for the low-rank path's k<=448 reduced Rayleigh block. Best commit 12251fe76, geomean 41378us, ~4.5% under parent 43301 (stable across 5 re-benchmarks 41353-41435, <0.2% spread), 39/39 validate. _lr_reduced_eigh routes Bk (B,k,k) through the RAW megakernel (mega_eigh k<=200 / mega_eigh_med 200<k<=448) with persistent (B,k)-cached scratch, NO wrapper gate, NO sort -- the outer FP32 A@V gate + _lowrank_eigh's final sort make both redundant. This fixed brief-7 t5's +41% regression exactly as the brief predicted (t5's tax was the top-level wrapper's per-call 7-buffer alloc + own residual gate incl an af@Q k-block GEMM + sort). Per-shape wins: dense512 k=352 132037->109627 (-17%), rankdef512 k=384 153142->121020 (-21%), lapgeom1024 k=384 55423->46508 (-16%). nsys: cuSOLVER laed3/gemvx/symv GONE from shape3, replaced by one mega_eigh_med_k (48.9%, 52ms).

k>448 blocks (dense1024 k=608, nearrank1024 k=768) REMAIN on the cuSOLVER floor -- FOUR inner solvers refuted with measurements: (1) nested randomized-subspace reduced solve +60-96% (t2), (2) cusolverDnXsyevBatched NEUTRAL (t4/5 -- for n>32 it launches the SAME symv/gemvx/laed3/larfg syevd machinery just looped, NOT genuinely batched; profile-confirmed), (3) Python blocked-Householder _eigh_custom 5.4x (t6, latency-bound per-column loop), (4) spectral 2-way matrix-sign split into two <=448 megakernel'd blocks +71-96% (t7). The nested+split share a FATAL failure: any approximation whose sub-block mixes subspaces -> non-orthonormal lifted eigenvectors -> the outer FP32 A@V gate falls the WHOLE batch to a full-n cuSOLVER eigh (~2x the shape cost) on top of the wasted work.

OPEN directions for a follow-up (all name the k>448 inner block, worth ~2% geomean if cracked -- shape4 inner eigh ~31% of 84ms, shape10 similar): (a) a DIRECT batched dense eigensolver that returns ALL k eigenpairs to gate accuracy WITHOUT truncation -- e.g. a fused SMEM megakernel that TILES the k>448 matrix out of SMEM (streams A-tiles from global, keeping the fused stage handoff), or a batched tensor-core dense->band->tridiag reduction feeding the existing Triton bisect/twisted solve + a single FP32-NS orthonormalization (avoids the Python per-column loop that killed t6) -- these overlap briefs 1/4/6's dense-reduction territory so coordinate; (b) a per-matrix VARIABLE-width spectral split (compute the true above-sigma count per matrix and gather same-width sub-blocks) to fix the fixed-k//2 subspace-mixing that killed t7 -- but the variable-width gather + the accurate FP32 sign make it expensive; (c) on the WINNING k<=448 side, the megakernel inner solve is barrier-bound (ncu: 47.6% barrier stalls, 50% occupancy, SMEM-capped at 1 CTA/SM) -- a lower-barrier / higher-occupancy megakernel variant (or tensor-core WY back-transform) could deepen the banked win further, but it is a shared kernel also serving shapes 1/2 so changes must be re-validated there.
